finalists.label: Panniculitis
finalists.why: It has specific evidence of fat necrosis with saponification from the cutaneous lesion biopsy.

finalists.label: Rheumatoid arthritis
finalists.why: It has specific evidence of polyarthralgia and synovitis, despite the negative autoimmune workup.

finalists.label: Fat Necrosis Secondary to Trauma
finalists.why: It has specific evidence of fat necrosis from the cutaneous lesion biopsy, similar to Panniculitis but with a different proposed mechanism.

finalists.label: Erythema Induratum
finalists.why: It is on the shortlist but lacks any for or against evidence, making it a weaker candidate by default.

frontier_selector.why: Panniculitis is chosen due to its direct evidence from the cutaneous lesion biopsy showing 'Ghost cells'—fat necrosis with saponification, which directly correlates with the patient's symptoms of painful lower-extremity nodules.
